result.finding: The web module exposes port 8080 (HTTP), consistent across the generated Dockerfile (EXPOSE 8080) and the Azure Container Apps deployment configuration (--target-port 8080). The worker module is a background service with no network port exposed. No server.port property is set in application.properties, so Spring Boot uses its default of 8080.
evidence: scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh line 332: '--target-port 8080' in Azure Container App creation for web module
worker/Dockerfile (generated): no EXPOSE instruction — background service with no HTTP port
web/application.properties: no 'server.port' override — Spring Boot default port 8080 applies
No docker-compose.yml or Kubernetes manifests present
values: Web module: port 8080 (HTTP, Spring Boot default)
Worker module: no port exposed (background AMQP consumer)
